transcript.text: Good morning, everyone. We need to conduct a pre-job review for the hot-work repair on Resin Dryer 2 — the cracked access-panel hinge that needs to be welded with a replacement hinge. Before I can authorize this work, I need to hear from each of you. Maintenance, please walk us through the repair plan and the welding scope. EHS, I need your assessment of fire and exposure controls given that this dryer is adjacent to the active compounding area. Production planning, tell us about current operations in that area and any scheduling considerations. And quality, please report any findings or concerns related to this repair. Once I have everyone's findings and we've documented all required controls, I can issue the permit and authorize the work to proceed.
